betterquesting:10.desc:8: Like most mods, Astral Sorcery has a guidebook. Follow it, it gives a bit better progression than the quest book in some regards.

You probably already know basic Botania. If not, read further down. Get some mana, you will need it. To fill the Petal Apothecary use bowls of water. Craft the AA bowl into a Botania bowl. I wish I could just make it the Botania Bowl but apparently if I disable AA bowls Botania bowls just don't work.

In the event you have never used Botania (or the even rarer event of this being your first taste of Modded Minecraft), welcome! This quest book will explain a large number of the features of the mods within it. If something is lacking, there is usually an in-game documentation from the mod itself.

To get some Mana, place down a Mana Pool, a Mana Spreader (linked to the pool in "Bind" mode), and some Endoflames (make sure they are also linked to the spreader). Throw some furnace fuel on the ground and the Endoflames will consume it to generate some Mana.

betterquesting:10.name:8: And Now For Something Completely Different
betterquesting:10.desc:8: Mana, being a form of energy, is quite good at removing the impurities in ores. It is so good that it ends up destroying some of the metal alongside the ore. However, it will have to do for the time being.
Make an Iron Pickaxe and go mine a Diamond.
Vanilla Bricks.

betterquesting:10.name:8: Don't Let This Bog You Down
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Make some Bog Earth, then place it in the world within 2 blocks of Water. Go do something else, as it will take a while for it to become ready for harvesting. Once it is ready, simply break it and you will get Peat. Use the Peat to make some Blend, and then smelt that into Bricks. You will want a lot of it, it is advisable to get several stacks of it if possible.

§2Hint: Mekanism Tanks act as large buckets when crafting, as regular ones do not stack.

§cMulti-step quests do not render as complete for each step, but as long as you make sure you have all of the materials, they will complete once the task is over. This is a bug with BQ.
This trip does not require anything fancy. Nothing will try to camp the spawn or anything ridiculous like that. Just grab some Netherrack and get out.
You will probably want a lot of Seared Bricks.
Now make a Smeltery. It allows for 1x Ore Processing as well as metal Tinker's parts.

Hello, and welcome to the world of multiblocks! Get ready for things you have never seen before. This particular multiblock must be built on top of bedrock. It is called the Bedrock Miner. Search for the uses of the Machine Controller to get a guide on how it is made. This particular one requires Mana as a power source. Mana-powered Modular Machines do not require an amount of mana per tick, but rather just a set amount: like a fluid, in a way. You will need many Bedrock Crystals in the future.
This pack has plenty of new alloys. The first of which is Duskstone. You will need it to make Manasteel. The first step is to make a Duskstone Mixer.

Some of Botania's Baubles are craftable in the Astral Sorcery Altars, earlier than they would be otherwise. You are welcome to craft them the other way later on if you wish, and I will not make quests for them. Check the last pages of JEI for the tables to find the recipes.
You can now make Manasteel. This marks the end of Chapter 1.

betterquesting:10.name:8: This One Should Resonate With You
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Resonator is the first machine that utilizes Grid Power, or GP. Grid Power is special as only special generators can actually create it. You will need 15 Solar Panels to start making Black Quartz.
The Plate Presser is an inefficient way of making plates. However, it is all you have. You know how multiblocks work by now, I would imagine.

The Calculator is a crafting tool that can add the properties of objects together. It cannot, however, do math. There's a different calculator for that. Just tick the box when you make it because BQ is deciding it doesn't want to accept the fact that you made a Calculator.
Iron Casings are Actually Additions' machine structure block.
The Eternal Fue- I mean Coal Generator is your first RF-Producing Generator. It creates 30 RF/tick and runs off of an item I won't say because it's a secret clearly.
The Powered Furnace can smelt two items at a time using RF power.

Energy Laser Relays transport energy without a need for cables. Simply shift-right-click on one and then do the same to another to link them and they will be part of the same energy network. They connect the power to adjacent blocks.
The Atomic Reconstructor allows you to create various Crystal items that are common crafting components in Actually Additions, as well as required for progression, of course.
The Power Cube allows you to store your energy and recharge your Calculator.

The Coke Oven is a 3x3x3 Multiblock made entirely out of Coke Brick. Right-click with an Engineer's Hammer to form it. It turns Coal into Coal Coke and Creosote Oil. It also produces double the Bricks from your Blend.

The Crude Blast Furnace makes Steel from Iron and Coal Coke (exclusively) at a rather slow rate. Do not upgrade to the Improved Blast Furnace. Trust me. You would be wasting your time. By the way. it is the same structure as the Coke Oven, if you care.
The Stone Separator allows you to get special ingots from ores that would normally require the Calculator. However, more importantly, you can get gemstones from it as well.
So close, but not quite. The Crusher gives you 1.5x yield from your ores, as well as lets you make certain dusts. You can also process your Black Quartz ore now.

The next step is to make the Super Alloyer. This machine lets you create various alloys that were previously unobtainable, as well as making some easier to obtain. Make the Super Alloyer and some Electrum.

This grants you access to many of Immersive Engineering's multiblocks. You can either go for the multiblock to get ore doubling now or wait until a little later for something that is not a giant multiblock.
This marks the end of Chapter 2. With Basic Machine Casings, you may begin creating IC2 machinery.
While not required, the Forge Hammer allows for much cheaper plates than the Plate Presser. You have suffered long enough.

These tools are vital for progression in IC2. The Cutter is a crafting tool, the Wrench allows you to pick up machines instantly as well as rotate them, and the Treetap allows you to get Sticky Resin from Rubber Trees.
This machine allows you to make Forestry's Circuit Boards, used in IC2 recipes. In addition, you can hydrate your Bog Earth near instantly into Peat.

The Scientific Calculator is a variant of the regular Calculator. It is effectively the same thing for different recipes, just dividing the properties (whatever that means) instead of adding them. This time with breaking laws of Mathematics!
A Generator that runs on Coal? You have never done that before.
Electronic Circuits are common crafting components in IC2 machinery.

Or a Flapjack. Or whatever you want to call them. The Compressor does its eponymous function. That is to say it compresses things. You can make Advanced Alloy, Carbon Plates, and Dense Plates with it, most notably.
The Drill is your first form of powered mining. It can craft into an IC2 Diamond Drill if empty.
I had to say it at least once. Anyway, the Vertical Digger mines in a 5x5 hole underneath it.
The Metal Former allows for hammering, extruding, and cutting things with ease for EU power.
The Extractor triples your Rubber output from Sticky Resin.
This generator makes EU with Lava as a fuel.
This thing exists. If you really want to use it, go ahead, knock yourself out.
Phantom Boosters increase the range of the Vertical Digger.
The Fluid/Solid Canning Machine is primarily useful for Coolant production, but it also can work for filling Uranium Cells and fluid cells.

betterquesting:10.name:8: In Case You Like Using EU
betterquesting:10.desc:8: This is literally just a furnace that uses EU. That simple.

betterquesting:10.name:8: Must Increase Velocity Over a Given Period of Time
betterquesting:10.desc:8: Or gotta go fast, if you prefer. Overclockers make IC2 machines use more power for lower processing time.
The Max Fastosity Macerator is your first single block ore doubling machine.
The LV_Transformer allows for conversion between LV and MV IC2 power. The side with more dots is the side with the higher voltage. Don't be an Incin. He never learned to transform his EU properly.
The Thermal Centrifuge can process Uranium Ore as well as make Lithium Dust production possible.
Display Stands can be used to show items and blocks, but also can be used to have Rings use their effects.
The Stirling Generator has been beefed up and it makes a large amount of MV EU Power. Remember that Transfomer.

The Empowerer can be used to make many more types of resources. To use it make 4 Display Stands and place each 2 blocks away (horizontally) from the Empowerer. Put the ingredients in and it will work, but the Display Stands need energy to do so.

The Luminous Crafting Table requires a clear view of the night sky and a decent elevation (between sea level and twice sea level) to work. Max efficiency is at y=128, any higher will not give any more.
Wait, I made that joke already. In any case, the Resonating Wand is the first tool of Astral Sorcery. It will be used primarily to activate the various Starlight Crafting Tables.
The Lightwell is used to collect Starlight in a liquid form. Simply place it down and put an Aquamarine or Rock Crystal on top of it and it will start collecting starlight.
The Starlight Crafting Altar is the first upgraded altar in Astral Sorcery. Crafting it transforms the Luminous Crafting Table instead of actually making an item. The Bucket is returned on use.
The Telescope allows for easier viewing of the stars.
Using the constellation papers, you can see stars in the night sky that make constellations, provided you have the correct papers for them.
The Linking Tool links sources of Starlight together. Simple enough.

Starmetal is a special metal infused with the power of Starlight and in a neat pretty shade of blue. It is a useful magical metal. You will need to link a Floating Crystal to Iron Ore to make Starmetal Ore. Then smelt a bunch of those down for Starmetal Nuggets. You will be able to get more later.

The Starmetal Factory requires a fair amount of Starmetal to construct, but in return you get a way to make Starmetal from Liquid Starlight and Manasteel. Later on you can upgrade the machine to accept more mundane metals.
The Celestial Altar has an even larger grid than before, and as a result requires a larger structure with more blocks and more Starlight. It also opens up more of Botania.
The Spectral Relay, when given a Glass Lens and placed near an Altar, will provide extra starlight to the altar.
Starlight infusion makes several resources in Astral Sorcery that you will need later on. It also needs its own multiblock, keep that in mind.
The Iridescent Altar is able to make very large crafts at the expense of a large amount of Starlight.

The Stellar Refraction Table allows you to make enchantments far more powerful than the regular Enchantment Table will allow. It is dependent on the constellations in the sky, however, so be careful. It also can only enchant unenchanted items.

The Runic Altar makes items from mana when you place a recipe on top of it. Right click the items onto the Altar. Once the proper amount of mana is received place a livingrock on top and right click with a Wand of the Forest.
Create some Runes of Water.
You're on a one way track to the Moon. And the Circuit Fabricator is the first step.
Get used to that... at least for a little while...
The NASA Workbench is where you will be assembling your rockets.

betterquesting:10.name:8: I Bet You're a Real Fan
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Oxygen Collector, when in the Overworld or around leaf blocks, will collect what other than Oxygen, which you need to breathe while in space.
The Oxygen Compressor takes Oxygen and fills tanks with it.
Put these on so you can survive in space, and the parachute is so you make it back alive. Fill your tanks in the Oxygen Compressor.
The Traveller's Sack is a portable item storage. You can filter items you do not want entering it. Or specify the only ones you do want.
The Industrial Coke Oven produces Coal Coke 9x faster than the normal Coke Oven, for 100 RF/tick.
Compact Machines allows you to store your multiblocks (or just several machines) into a nice small space of a single block. The
Well, not the smallest, but the first that can hold some of the smaller multiblocks and still let you move inside of it. It has a 5x5x5 inside.
Waystones are a more MP-friendly alternative to Celestial Gateways. Use what suits your situation best.

The Double Gear system allows you to place a gearbox on top of the machine controller in compatible Modular Machines to give the machine a boost.

§1The Speed Gearbox raises the process speed and energy requirements of the machine, by 50% and 60% respectively.

§cThe Power Gearbox decreases the energy requirement to 60% and increases the process time to 110%
The Ultimate Crafting Table handles 9x9 recipes. Not many recipes use this table, do not worry.
The Iron Backpack is a full inventory worth of portable storage.
Uranium can be used for basic starter reactor fuel.
Extreme Reactors are slightly weaker than their Nuclearcraft counterparts but require less setup. From their defaults, they generate 0.75x the power they normally generate.
Builder Wands can place the same material over and over on a face of the material you are placing.
Astral Rituals are here because I put them here. Mineralis is disabled.
This one stores 13x13x13 which can store quite a lot inside of it.
Bowls can be used in place of a Pot in some recipes. Check JEI!
The Health Module can refill your life bar as it depletes. Fill it in a Health Processor supplied with Mob Drops.
The Nutrition Module is merely a combination of the two modules used to craft it.
The Hunger Module restores your food bar with its stored hunger points. Fill it in a Hunger Processor filled with food.
The Liquid Fuel Generator creates RF from a hot fluid and a cold fluid. Colder fluids increase power output per tick, while hotter fluids increase total power production.
Gas-burning generators are a good way of making mid-lategame power before you get a reactor going. You might be able to make use of Jupiter's atmospheric Hydrogen...
The Crafting Table on a Stick is exactly what it sounds like.
Don't want to breed or find trees in the world? Here's another option.
The Electric Compressor is exactly what it sounds like. It is also able to make 2 compressed plates at once.

betterquesting:10.name:8: And Then We'll Go to Space I Don't Know
betterquesting:10.desc:8: Find a few handfuls of oil, shove it up your bum, and then we'll go to space I don't know. Seriously though, find some oil in the world and get some.
You will need some fuel to get your rocket going. Make a lot of it, you will need to be able to get back.
Put fuel in the Fuel Loader in front of a 3x3 array of Launch Pads.

Now make the rocket. Place it on the launch pad and when the loader is powered it will load fuel into the rocket. Make sure to bring: §1Oxygen Gear, Oxygen Mask, Filled Oxygen Tanks, Parachute, §2Frequency Module, Extra Filled Oxygen Tanks, §6Fuel Loader, Extra Fuel, Empty Canisters,§f §4Decent Armor, Decent Weapons, Some Tools, Food, §5Something that Stores or Makes Energy,§f and anything else you might want. Oh, and by the way, the rocket has no storage on it. Just to make sure it counts for your quest.

§1Something you need to breathe
§2Optional things you might want
§6Fuel things to get home§4
Things for combat and mining
§5Miscellaneous stuff
Conglaturation, you landed on the Moon. Collect a soil sample.
Meteors land on the surface of the Moon. Go and mine one.

Things are a bit different in this pack. There are custom dungeons on each major celestial body, and they give an otherwise unobtainable treasure as a reward for clearing it. You cannot cheese the dungeons by breaking through them, be warned.
Maybe a little more than twice as far. Make a Tier 2 Rocket. It will enable you to get to Mars.
Get some Desh. You can find it in ore veins on Mars.
Make a Tier 4 rocket. To cut down on the tedium, you will only be making even tiered rockets from here on out.

Asteroids can be rich in Titanium. Go find an asteroid with Titanium in it. There is no really easy way other than digging in and seeing what is inside.

Alternatively, make a Bacterial Processor and process Asteroid Rock.
Dig into Mercury to find Carbon Ore for your Carbon Ingots.
Go to Venus and search for crashed probes. Break them to get Radioisotope Cores, which are used for making reactors.
It is time once again to make a rocket. Make a Tier 6 Rocket.
Saturn has deposits of Magnesium. Go find some.
Jupiter sure has a lot of Lightning. And Fire. And Magma. Just go mine some Palladium.

betterquesting:10.name:8: YOU GOT A CRYSTAL STA- I Mean Ingot
betterquesting:10.desc:8: Uranus contains Crystal Ore. Go get some.
Tier 8 gives you access to most of the planets in the Solar System.
Zinc is Neptune's metal.
Tungsten is Pluto's metal.
You may now access everywhere in the known universe that actually exists. Not things that arent programmed though.
Eris contains Dark Iron.
Kepler 22b is an entirely separate galaxy accesible with the Tier 10 Rocket. Go collect its resources.

The Bacterial Culture Farm accepts an input of sludge and either wheat or meat and outputs bacterial sludge. Do note the tank needs to be full for it to work, as you cannot grow more bacteria from nothing. Be careful with the tank too, you cannot break it without it losing its contents.
Create some Runes of Fire.
Create some Runes of Earth.
Create some Runes of Air.
Make a Rune of Winter.
Make a Rune of Spring.
Make a Rune of Autumn.
Make a Rune of Summer.

The Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate, when placed on an array of 5 Livingrock and 4 Lapis Lazuli Blocks in a 3x3 horizontal checkerboard pattern, is capable of producing Terrasteel. For each ingot of Terrasteel you will need 1 Manasteel, 1 Mana Pearl, and 1 Mana Diamond, as well as half of a pool of mana.
The Gourmaryllis creates mana from consumable objects. More saturation will let it last longer whereas the hunger restored determines how much it makes per tick.
Make your first ingot of Terrasteel.

betterquesting:10.name:8: You Want it Bad, Don't You?
betterquesting:10.desc:8: Make a Rune of Lust.
Make a Rune of Gluttony.
Make a Rune of Greed.

betterquesting:10.name:8: I Don't Really Feeeeeeeeeel Like It
betterquesting:10.desc:8: Make a Rune of Sloth.
Make a Rune of Wrath.
Make a Rune of Pride.
Make a Rune of Envy
Create a Rune of Mana.

The Elven Portal can be made using the design shown in the Lexica Botania. Activate it when the pools have mana in them by using a Wand of the Forest on the core. And no, there is no dimension to go to.
Throw 2 Manasteel into the portal to get back an ingot of Elementium.
Throw a Mana Pearl into the portal to get back a Pixie Dust.
Throw a Mana Diamond into the portal and get Dragonstone back.
It means God. Fight the Gaia Guardian by performing the ritual and obtain some Gaia Spirits.
The Kekimurus is one of the best generating flowers in the game. It eats cake that is placed in the world. All cakes work, Pam's included, not just vanilla.
Using a Gaia Spirit in place of the Terrasteel Ingot, fight the Gaia Guardian II.
The Flugel Tiara is your first form of flight on the magic side of things. It requires mana to work. You also need to go to the Moon and the End to get it.
The Gaia Mana Spreader allows for maximum mana transferrance short of using Sparks.

Corporea Networks allow for an inventory system if you do not want to touch Applied Energistics or Refined Storage. To use it simply place down the Corporea Index and place a Master Corporea Spark on top of it. Then place a Corporea Spark over the chest you want to connect. You can request items by typing it in the chat.
The Elven Mana Spreader is an upgraded Mana Spreader that can sent more mana in a pulse.
The Loonium will generate dungeon loot when provided with ridiculous amounts of mana.
The Globetrotter's Sash allows for step assist as well as faster movement speed and higher jumping height.
The Machine Frame is Thermal Expansion's standard machine block.
The Pulverizer is your gateway to better ore processing, when provided the right augments.
The Induction Smelter is a compact 2-item-type alloy smelter. You can also make several new alloys with it.

betterquesting:10.name:8: No, it is Not Made of Redstone
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Redstone Furnace is an augmentable RF powered furnace.

This is the first upgrade to your Thermal Expansion machines. It will allow for an extra augment slot as well as improve the energy storage of the machine it is used on. Simply right click the machine with the upgrade to upgrade it.
This is the next tier upgrade, does the same general stuff as the previous one.
Blah blah blah you get it by now.
No resonating jokes here.
The Magma Crucible can liquify a number of materials into liquid states. These liquids can be used to make new alloys as well as some interesting fluids.
The Fluid Transposer can store fluids and inject them into tanks or various items.
Pyrotheum Dust is a super hot dust than can be melted into Blazing Pyrotheum. It is also used in ore processing.
Cryotheum Dust is the coldest dust around. It melts into Gelid Cryotheum, a premier coolant fluid.
Tectonic Petrotheum is an earthen dust that is useful in ore processing.
Aerotheum Dust is useful for moving things around, particularly in Viaducts for a fun type of player transport.
Jetpacks are your first form of RF-powered flight.
The Hardened Jetpack is the upgraded form of the Leadstone Jetpack.
The next Jetpack tier is naturally faster than the previous ones.
The Resonant Jetpack is yet another upgraded jetpack.
The Flux-Infused Jetplate is the fastest of all Jetpacks.
This augment allows for tripling of ores when you have Tectonic Petrotheum.
This augment allows for ore quadrupling. You will need a supply of Blazing Pyrotheum to use it.
Reservoirs are basically just bigger buckets.
Batteries do exactly what you would expect them to do. Shift Right Click to activate their charge.
The Horn of the Wild is a lawn mower taped to a flute. Don't ask how it works. (Hold right click to harvest crops and break grass)
Boron isn't all that useful early on, but it makes better tools than Iron, and isn't as important so you arent wasting it.
Tier 1 Cooking Utility, capable of juicing foods.
Capacitors store RF (and equivalent) energy inside of them and can charge tools that use it.
The Saucepan is a Tier 2 Cooking Tool.
The Mortar and Pestle is a Tier 1 Cooking Tool.

betterquesting:10.name:8: M-I-X The Flour Into the Bowl
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Mixing Bowl is a Tier 2 Cooking Tool.
The Bakeware is a Tier 3 Cooking Tool.

betterquesting:10.name:8: Press ` to Open the Quest Book
betterquesting:10.desc:8: Good you already did it now I don't have to have people ask me if there are quests.
The Bacterial Processor uses the Bacteria from farming to eat away at planet rock to get material from inside it. The amount and type of material depends on where it came from.
The MV-Transformer is a device that allows for you to transform between MV and HV power. You now have access to Tier 3 and all of its generators.
The HV-Transformer can turn EV (Tier 4) energy into Tier 3 energy. You now have access to all energy tiers in IC2.

betterquesting:10.name:8: No Man, You're Thinking of Beep Boop Boop Bop
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Mass Fabricator produces UU-matter when supplied with EU power. It also likes to beep and boop.
The Scanner creates a digital imprint of any compatible item, and determines the amount of UU-Matter needed to replicate said item. It will auto-output scans to adjacent Pattern Storages.
The Pattern Storage holds pattern data for items, if you do not want to use Crystal Memories (which you likely do not).

The Replicator is the final part of IC2's replication system. It is the machine responsible for actually creating the items based on the pattern selected from the Pattern Storage or Crystal Memory (as well as eating through all of your power and UU-Matter).
The MFE allows for you to charge Tier 3 items as well as store much more energy. Keep in mind that it outputs Tier 3 power, so you must transform down energy twice.
The MFSU stores an absolute ton of EU power. Same rules apply as the MFE, just raise the tier to 4 and take proper precautions.
Iridium Ore must be obtained by compressing Iridium Shards, then scanning and replicating in the Replicator using UU-matter.
The Atomic Calculator is a new crafting calculator that uses 3 different items at the same time.
The Steel Casing does the exact same thing as any other case block.

Other than the factory ability of it, the Enrichment Chamber is not unique in its ore processing. However, it IS able to enrich components for the Metallurgic Infuser to octuple their strength. In addition, it will be necessary for the Mekanism processing chain.
The Energized Smelter is a good powered smelter that can both be fast and do up to 7 operations at once.
The Metallurgic Infuser is useful for creating Mekanism's Alloys, which are used in most of Mekanism's machines and their upgrades.
Installers upgrade your machines to factories. That simple. Basic tier gives 3 slots.

The Electrolytic Separator separates water into Hydrogen and Oxygen. Hydrogen is more commmonly used as a fuel or to make fuel, while Oxygen is more useful for processing (and using tanks to convert you can use it for Galacticraft air if you want).
Advanced Factories have 5 slots.
Elite Factories have 7 slots. And Ultimate Factories do not exist.
The Purification Chamber allows for tripling of ores if supplied with Oxygen. You can either use Electrolytic Separators, or if you want something real easy, Oxygen Collectors.
The Crusher crushes things. It also is used in Mekanism's processing chain.
The Atomic Disassembler is an Omnitool and a melee weapon all in one! It can even hoe the ground.
The Speed Upgrade does exactly what you'd expect it to. Click the upgrade tab on the Mekanism machine's GUI to insert it.
Energy Upgrades increase the energy capapcity of Mekanism machines, as well as lower their power consumption. Open the upgrade tab in the GUI of a Mekanism machine to insert it.

The Thermal Evaporation Tower is a complex multiblock that creates Brine from Water and some form of heat. You can pipe heat in through a valve, as well as water in and the produced Brine out. It gains heat from the environment as well, so if you have access to a hot biome, it would be beneficial to set it up there.
The Chemical Infuser is used to turn gaseous chemicals into other gaseous chemicals by reacting them together. Most of the products are some form of acid, mostly used for ore processing.
The Chemical Injection Chamber uses power and Hydrochloric Acid to quadruple your ore output.
The Digital Miner is an upgrade on your previous mining implements, as it can whitelist what you want it to mine instead of just mining everything or all ores.
The Solar Neutron Activator is responsible for creating Lithium from Brine. It is useful for creating Tritium, to be used in Fusion Reactors.
The Chemical Oxidizer takes substances and oxidizes them, creating various oxygenated compounds.
The Chemical Crystallizer takes your ore cleansed ore slurries and converts them into crystals.
The Pressurized Reaction Chamber, or PRC, uses Mekanism gases as well as fluids and solids to create new products.
The Chemical Washer cleans your ore slurries.
The Chemical Dissolution Chamber takes your ores and breaks them down using Sulfuric Acid.

Rudimentary Snares are a non-damaging projectile that give you a chance to obtain Demonic Will when thrown at an enemy. Craft some, throw one at an enemy, and if it emits white swirly particles, kill it quickly. If not, it might take a few tries. Do note that Will will vary in quality (no, seriously).
The Quantum Entangoloporter is a strict upgrade to the Tesseract. It can do Power, Items, Fluids, Gases, and even Heat!
The Induction Matrix is a multiblock huge capacity RF storage option. That being said, they don't do well with performance, so you might not want to get too big.
The Flawless Calculator is the top tier of Calculator. It uses 4 items in its recipes.
Draconium is a key metal that can only be obtained by processing Draconium Ore in the Chemical Dissolution Chamber, at least for now.
Draconic Cores are the first tier of Draconic Evolution crafting component.
Crafting Injectors are a core component of fusion crafting. You must place the injectors facing the Fusion Crafter.
Wyvern Cores are the next tier core up from Draconic. They are used in more complex components.
Higher tier crafting injectors are capable of supporting higher tier recipes. You can mix and match for lower tier recipes, though.
Make some Awakened Draconium, and turn it into an Awakened Core.

betterquesting:10.name:8: I'm Running Out of Ideas for Quest Names
betterquesting:10.desc:8: It's true.
At the edge of the End (or just x10000 z10000 and similar) there lies a Chaos Guardian. It is a tough fight, so be sure to bring adequate weaponry and upgraded Draconic Armor.
Wyvern Armo(u)r runs on a separate shield system to protect you, which recharges over time from the power it stores.
Wyvern Tools are generally much stronger than standard tools of their type. Wyvern Swords are also capable of obtaining mob souls, useful for powerful spawners.
Draconic Tools are upgraded from Wyvern ones.
Draconic Armor is super strong and uses RF to generate a shield that absorbs damage.
The Draconic Staff of Power is a strong omnitool made from the Draconic level tools.
Oh wow another crafting component how completely unexpected and amazing.

Look out for them all! The Draconic Energy Sphere is an extremely large energy storage device. It is made of dragon-themed material and is relatively spherical, it's a Dragon Ball and you cannot convince me otherwise. They come in many tiers, look up how to make them in the tablet.
You will need to use larger crafting tables to create more complex machinery. For now, it is entirely manual, but you won't need to make everything ever on it, so it works out.
The RFTools Machine Frame is the last type you must construct. It will give you access to dimension building for mass production of any realistic resources.
Dimlets are what you use to create dimensions. They can determine the dimension's composition and features.
You will want to actually build the dimension. Guess what the Dimension Builder does?
These Dimensions won't run themselves. You must construct one to be able to use it, clearly.
The Dimension Enscriber does exactly what its tooltip says.
Dimensional Shards are a decently rare ore found in your created dimensions that can empower your RFTools machines and also craft some special components.
The Infusion Crystal is a key tool towards one form of resource acquisition. Many methods are available, do note this is only one of them.
Prudentium Essence is the second tier of essence, used for Tier 2 seeds.
Intermedium is the third tier of essence.
Superium is the fourth tier of essence.
Supremium is the fifth tier of essence.
Insanium is the sixth and final tier of essence.

The Fission Reactor is a multiblock that accepts fuel pellets and turns them into RF energy. Each pellet has its own heat and energy production rate. Look up some reactor designs online and figure out which one you want to go with, or perhaps tinker with it yourself in a test world first.

The Fusion Reactor is a very powerful generator that accepts any combination of 7 different fuels. You are required to feed its electromagnets a constant 20k RF/tick to keep it going, so you will want a large amount to start with.
Processors can only be made from cut silicon and some other materials together. This multiblock is used to make raw processors.
Grids and Terminals allow you to interact with items stored in your RS or ME Network. Either item is accepted.
Drives, when connected to a network, can be filled with drives and act as a giant storage repository.
The ME Interface allows automation with connected machines and storages. It accepts patterns that are programmed in the Pattern Terminal.

The Crafter merges the Interface and Molecular Assembler, and is able to craft things on its own. In addition, it acts as an Interface, reading off of the attached machine or inventory. It will override its status as a crafter if it is touching a machine, so if you want to use it for normal crafting, make sure it is not touching anything.
The Pattern Terminal allows you to construct recipes to be programmed into patterns.
The Pattern Grid allows you to encode RS Patterns with recipes.
To start with Bees, you will need to go out into the world and break their hives with a Scoop. They might not like it, though, so bee careful and don't take too much damage.
Once you find a hive and break it, it will drop some or all of the following: Princess, Drones, and Combs (of an appropriate type for the hive).

Don't worry, for you family friendly peoples out there, the swearing is minimal and restricted to references. In any case, the Apiary is an automatable bee breeder. You will need a Princess, Drone, (or queen in place of both), some flowers placed nearby, and a view of the sky. Preferably in a sufficient biome for the bees.
Honey is a byproduct of processing Honeycombs in a Centrifuge.
The Analyzer uses honey to determine the species of bees and trees, as well as other miscellaneous details.
If desired, you may invest in obtaining an early AE system with limited function. You cannot craft extras yet, but you may replace the storage scanner with this, as it works a bit better.
The Industrial Apiary is an automatic bee farmer.
The Elite Crafting Table is a 7x7 size crafting grid. It will make specific larger recipes for complex items.
Neutronium Compressors take a large sum of a given material and compress it down into a singularity. You will not need to make endless singularities, only some of 4 types.

Singularities are a lot of a single type of thing. You will only need to make Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Emerald Singularities. You may use whatever method you wish to achieve this. You could get innovative or just spam seeds, I don't care, I gave you the option to do what you want, you have many methods and should use whichever you want.
Gold singularities are the second required singularity type.
The Diamond Singularity is the third singularity.
Emeralds are the last singularity.

Sometimes you just want to plug a crate or a drawer wall into your network. This is where Storage Buses come in. They allow you to "read" an inventory and have your system interact with it as opposed to shoving all the items into a storage cell on a drive.

AE Autocrafting requires you to have available crafting processing power in order to make things. It applies to all types of recipes. Larger crafting storages allow for more complex requests, but each can only take one single request at a time. If big enough, however, it can handle complex items that use many steps.
The Crafting Grid (and Crafting Terminal) allow you to craft from your network instead of having to retrieve the items and use them in a Crafting Table.
Neutron Collectors slowly acquire Piles of Neutrons.
Piles of Neutrons are slowly accumulated in the Neutron Collector.

The Interface Terminal allows you to view and interact with all ME Interfaces in your network. It sorts alphabetically by the connected inventory/machine (Chest comes before Hopper comes before Pulverizer, for example).

Plug a Molecular Assembler onto a ME Interface and it will act as an autocrafter. Typically, it is idea to run a separate line from your controller where 8 assemblers are a adjacent with a tube of 4 assemblers touching each. Assemblers do not take up a channel.

betterquesting:10.name:8: Mom Said Give Me the Controller
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Controllers of these mods function a bit differently. The ME Controller is not needed to run a ME network, but allows for more than 8 channels (8 per connection) and can be made into a multiblock. The RS Controller is different, it is the main power source of the network and is requires for it to function.

You might have noticed a lack of Sky Stone in the world. Meteors have been disabled, as well as their presses and the Inscriber. This is in favor of the much more simple to automate Processor Cutter. To get Sky Stone, you must smelt End Stone and Moon Turf together in the Induction Smelter.
im lazy read the other controller quest
The Network Receiver and Transmitter are a way to wirelessly link your network across a large distance. Link a Network Card to the receiver, then place it in the Transmitter's inventory.

The Matter Condenser, when supplied with a large supply of items, will create singularities if a 64K storage component is in its slot. You must pump the items in. There might be a multiblock capable of making this large quantity of items...

Quantum Rings must contain an entangled singularity to function. Each comes as a pair, so don't lose either! Assemble 2 Quantum Rings to connect your ME network to other locations. Useful for widespread bases, or perhaps other dimensions.

The Wireless Grid is a way to access your system from a remote distance. It must be in range of a Wireless Transmitter. You can place range upgrades into the Transmitter to be able to access it from a longer distance. Shift right click a controller with it to link.

The Wireless Terminal allows wireless access to your ME Netowrk. It must be in range of a Wireless Access Point and linked with a Security Terminal. You can use Wireless Boosters to increase the range.
That Petty gem isn't going to get you far. Upgrade it so you can store more Will in it and craft better things.
A Tier 3 Blood Altar allows you to make Imbued Slates, which are essential to any thought of better tools and runes.
Routing Nodes are another magical storage sorting option. Feel free to use them in conjunction with the Corporea system.
The Common Tartaric Gem is the next step up. Its larger capacity allows for more recipes in the Hellfire Forge.

Your basic Altar is kind of inefficient. If you had a way of augmenting it, it would be very helpful. Replace the Blood Runes on your altar with a specified upgrade to get a benefit from it. Self Sacrifice Runes allow more LP per self-use, Sacrifice Runes allow for more LP from other mobs. There are many more, but these are some of the more basic and more helpful for you right now.
Upgrading your Blood Orb will allow you to make more complex items.
A Remix of the previous Remixes! Industry and progress have gotten you to where you are now. Use it to mass produce many different things!
The final challenge. This will incorporate all of your Modded Minecraft knowledge that you have gained and utilized in this pack.
A Remix of the Remixes! Sorcery and mystical energies have guided you to this point. Now you must use the knowledge you have gained to create its elements!
You are almost at the end! You have but three challenges remaining... persevere!
§cWelcome to the Remix!

The Rocket Assembler upgrades rockets into their next tier when supplied with sufficient materials. You can still hunt down schematics if you really want to, but it is by no means required, it's boring.
The tooltip explains exactly what this does.
Merely making empowered crystals is not enough to get you out of the Overworld's atmosphere. You will need to empower those crystals into metal ingots to make machines for rocket building.

I'm sure you are tired of making Duskstone Ingots the primitive way. Don't worry, there is a better way. It is a bit of an investment but it will pay off greatly. The Duskstone Factory allows you to make Duskstone Ingots, not only in one step, but also doubling your output. You get 4 Duskstone Ingots per 1 Gold Ingot and 1 Obsidian.

The Oil Generator uses various tiers of Oil to produce RF power. Yes AA calls it CF its the same stuff as long as it isn't EU or some fancy pants rotational energy. You will need to press canola grown from canola plants and ferment it into regular Refined Oil. Each Generator produces 80 RF/tick with Refined Oil.
Crystallized Oil is the result of tossing a Crystallized Canola Seed into Oil placed in the world. It generates 100 RF/tick in the Oil Generator.
Empowered Oil is the best fuel for the Oil Generator. It allows each generator to produce 120 RF/tick.
The Kinetic Dynamo is the connector block for the passive IE power generators.
The Windmill generates power from an unknown source, nobody has any idea what makes it move but it sure has nothing to do with its name.
Water Wheels generate energy using what other than water. Well I suppose any fluid that will not burn the Water Wheel will work. But still. It is passively generated RF, though it isnt too much.
The Thermionic Fabricator makes Electron Tubes, which are required to make your first automatic farms, Forestry's Multifarms.

To assemble a Multifarm, you will need the bare minimum of these components. The Gearbox is the power input, the Hatch is the item input and output, the Valve is the fluid input, and the Control handles redstone signals. Make a 3x3x4 box of a combination of farm blocks and these special blocks to make the core of the farm. Then place the appropriate material on the level of on of the box layers, surrounding the layer and the area around that. Place dirt over the material and that will register as your farm plot. Do note that you can only place the material on one of the lower three layers. Use laser relays to retrieve and feed the farm for products and fertilizer, respectively. You also need to till the land yourself for the farm to plant the seeds.

Quartz Enriched Iron is a primary component for your storage needs. It, alongside Certus Quartz, will be essential for Refined Storage and Applied Energistics. It is made in the Induction Smelter. §cWhile you are here, something to note: Most of Applied Energistics will be an alternative to Refined Storage. AE has more potential while RS is simpler. Any equivalent items and blocks between the mods will be interchangable via 1 to 1 crafting (minus crafting components, of course). The one you want to go with is up to personal preference. Neither is required for endgame, as it is a reward for making it this far. Obviously, it is your ticket to autocrafting for the endgame, however. So while you are not forced to use either in most situations, it is recommended. All of the tasks in here are optional, even though some will have the "Main Line" denotation. In addition, AE2 is better for stability and performance, so if you are on a large server, I would recommend it over RS.

The Attunement Altar is a rather powerful device that lets you augment yourself and items to have unique abilities. To use it you will need to create a multiblock shown in the Astral Tome, and then create the shape of the constellation you want using Spectral Relays. Then stand on the Attunement Altar. To see where to place each relay hold the Constellation Paper for the constellation you want in your off hand.
The Celestial Gateway is a useful tool for linking areas together.
A Mantle of the Stars with a Vicio buff will allow mock flight. Combined with a Vicio Resonating Wand, you can fly faster than any jetpack can dream of going. However, you can crash too.

The Blood Altar is used to collect Blood that you take from yourself using a Life Collector. Make some space for it, though. It gets rather large (I would look up the dimensions if I were you if you plan to make it not look like crap). The Life Collector takes a lot of focus and energy to use, so it will end up wearing you out in the process of using it to generate Life Points.
By soaking enriched stone into a Blood Altar filled with Life Essence, you can create Blank Slates. They are a common crafting component for Blood Magic.
The Weak Blood Orb is the first of several tiers of Blood Orb, used in Blood Magic's crafting recipes. It needs to be bound to the player to work, so right click with it in your hand.

The Blood Altar requires runes of any type to be placed in a special configuration around it. The first tier is merely 8 runes in a square ring (circle ring? whatever it would be called...) on the y level directly underneath the altar. (If the altar is at y=50, it would be at y=49).
Arcane Ashes are used for creating all types of Sigils within Blood Magic.
So, all that Will you have been collecting has a purpose. You will need it to get started with the Hellfire Forge, a crafting mechanic of Blood Magic.

Petty Tartaric Gems are a first tier Will storage item. It will automatically add any will you pick up into itself. It can be used in place of Will in the Hellfire Forge. You will likely want two so you can upgrade them simultaneously.

This section provides with some basic bases. It will show you how making one of them works. If you get more than one schematic, you will need to use both to assemble the structure. There are keybinds to ungrid and rotate the blueprint, check them under Architect.
No Description
No Description
The Seared Furnace is a 12 slot furnace that uses lava as fuel. It is very useful early game for mass smelting.
No Description

§bWelcome to the Remix! §rThis is where we mix everything up in a temporarily optional side quest for a unique reward. You do not need to complete any remixes until the endgame. You may move on to the next chapter if you so please, or are just barely scraping by on materials and do not want to invest in this yet. It will be an automation-focused challenge where you must mass produce a special item utilizing the machines found within the chapter.

§b§§§bReward:§r A Leadstone Jetpack, which is normally much later, gated by space and Thermal Expansion.
The Magician's Blood Orb is the next tier orb up.
Modularium is an important alloy for Modular Machines. For now, you must inefficiently craft it by hand.
The Machine Controller is a special block that defines what a Modular Machine is. It is the centerpiece of the machines you will be making, though it by itself doesn't do much.

Install a Damaging or Entropic lens to use the Mana Blaster as a weapon! But be careful with the entropic one, you might not like the results if it was fired in your base...

You can fire faster if you have a haste effect for what is basically a magic laser gun.

The Luminizer can be used as a form of transportation. Simply link the start to the destination using a Binding Wand of the Forest to set a path. You can make a 2 way chain, or make a whole network! Beware that most of it only works one way.
No Description
Alumite is back because PlusTiC is so here have the alumite quest again.
Cobalt, Ardite, and their alloy, Manyullyn, make for good tool materials. Each one has a part it is better for, so use it wisely.

§rMekanical Remix is a bit different from the other ones. Instead of an item reward, since this is so late, one of the products you make is useful for more than just the remix. Nital is a fantastic industrial etching agent composed of 70% miracle fluid and 30% concentrated ethanol, and it can even break down the greatest of rock formations. It can be used to extract empowered crystals from gems, among other things. This is a tough regular remix, and you will want to make sure you keep your Nital production for later.

Remember your autocrafters!
You can automate the Starlight Infuser with a Mechanical User set to "Activate Block With Item"
This also works for Lightwells
You can output the Liquid Starlight from the bottom of the Lightwells
You can also place a Containment Chalice next to a Lightwell to automatically output (and in the right spot, feed the Starlight Infuser)

Make a Tier 4 Blood Altar using more runes and Bloodstone. You should know the drill by now.

Isaac and his Isaac lived in a small Isaac... Make a Binding Reagent and create a Bound Blade with it. The Bound Blade consumes your internal LP to function and will damage you if it runs out, so disable it when not in use. You can defeat mobs with it to get a Weak Blood Shard.

Fun Fact: I just combined a Gaia Spirit Ingot, Life Essence, and Starmetals' colors, and it ended up being Red, White, and Blue with White Stars... Anyway, you will need to make a Starblood Infuser to create Bloodshine Ingots, used in late magic crafting.
For the purposes of this pack, this is the highest your blood altar and orb need to go.

A Master Ritual Stone and a Ritual Diviner are capable of making complex Blood Magic Rituals that use Life Points for varying effects. The Ritual Altars are many different shapes and sizes depending on the ritual you want to perform, so take that into account when making space for them. Activate with a Weak Activation Crystal. Shift right or left click the Diviner to scroll through your options and hold right click on the master stone to make it build.
Steam Dynamos use steam (or coal and water) to generate power.
Magmatic Dynamos use Lava and Blazing Pyrotheum to generate power. They are not as efficient or powerful as the Liquid Fuel Generator, but it is easier to make a lot of them.
The Compression Dynamo is a direct cousin of the Liquid Fuel Generator, having a larger array of fuels and coolants but overall less powerful.
The Reactant Dynamo uses a solid fuel item and a liquid fuel fluid as reactants. Could require some more interesting setups.
The Enervation Dynamo is the strangest of the bunch... just look at the weird stuff it uses...
The Numismatic Dynamo turns coins into power... perhaps an automated metal setup of sorts could be used for it.
Solar Energy is free and easy to get during the daytime. It isn't very powerful, however. So I wouldn't recommend running your entire base off of Solar Energy.
Unlike real life, you can upgrade your solar setups to be a lot more effective and for a much easier to obtain investment.
The Skillet is a Tier 3 Cooking Tool, capable of grilling foods.

betterquesting:10.name:8: I'm Going to Make Paper Dolls Out of You
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Cutting Board is a Tier 4 Cooking Tool.

betterquesting:10.name:8: How Do I Make a Pot, Pam?
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Pot is a Tier 4 Cooking Tool.
The Lunchbox stores 32 of each food stack inside of it. It automatically makes you eat a food you havent eaten recently.

betterquesting:10.name:8: A Good Chef Always Follows the Recipe
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Cooking Table lets you cook any recipe you like provided you have the ingredients and tools. It connects to other CfB kitchen parts.
The Oven allows you to cook your foods if you provide it with fuel (or power if you give it the upgrade to do so).
All Toasters Toast Toast. Toasters can make Toast from bread without Butter or a Skillet.
The Sink provides water to cooking recipes.
The Tool Rack stores cooking tools to be used in recipes. Very surprising, I know.
The Milk Jar stores Milk, and the upgraded Cow In A Jar lets you get free milk.

I'll make this simple.
You need a mere 3 different foods to not get diminishing returns. Not 12. Not 6. 3. This is more than doable.
In addition, you will gain 1 extra heart for each milestone reached. every 5 hearts the total increases by 5 to reach the next milestone. You can gain up to 20 extra hearts (for a total of 30) this way. 5 foods, then 10, then 15, then 20.

The penalty is minimal for a lack of a varied diet, you can easily get away with 3. If you decide to pursue more options you will get more hearts. However, you can live off 3 easy foods no problem.

Cooking tools are divided into 4 tiers. Each tool allows more foods to be made. See what you can do with the tools you have.

The Block Duplicator allows you to create infinite building blocks from a tiny bit of power. 5 RF/block. Most Chiselable blocks are supported. Do note for the structure to form, you need to load the craftable version of the block into it (vanilla stone, the cobble temple block, etc).
The Machine Part Crafter makes machine blocks for modular machines much easier and cheaper than other methods.

The Storage Scanner detects all items in inventories that it sees in its scan radius. When adding more inventories you will need to rescan. You can also put in items through the blue slot and take them out by searching for them.

The Orechid places a specific list (not yet fixed) of ores into vanilla stone. It cannot get you too many rare and different ores, but it can get you most of the stuff found in the overworld. Magic equivalent to the Lens of the Miner.
The Tree Fluid Extractor takes Tree Resin out of logs placed in front of it.
The Latex Processing unit turns tree fluids into solid latex.
The Plant Gatherer harvests trees and crops.
The Space Laser Drill can only be used to mine space ores in their respective dimensions. It requires its own multiblock, however... the multiblock ensures you can't cheat and do it anywhere.
The Animal Separator splits the young from the mature.

The Plant Sower plants seeds, saplings, and crops.
The Animal Rancher milks cows, shears sheep, and other related animal harvestings.
The Lens of the Miner can get you large quantities of common overworld ores. Do note that not all ores are obtainable.
You can now make the Master Infusion Crystal, which has no durability, making it suitable for autocrafting.

Now to switch to bad tree puns... Tree breeding happens when bees or butterflies are active around forestry trees. You will need to find some trees in the world to start, or make the Analyzer to convert vanilla saplings to Forestry ones.

Ah, IC2. Don't worry, I fixed some of the common complaints with it. Not all of them, but it's more tolerable.
Astral Sorcery is a neat magic mod with some overpowered stuff in it. Of course you will need to earn said stuff.
Although they look pretty far... you will have to reach for the stars. Or at least the other planets.
Flowers and stuff. Fun times.
Thermal Expansion makes its home here. It is also the first Tech chapter to allow flight.
You need to eat to live, and that simple stuff doesn't always cut it.

No Fairies to nerf you here.
You'll need more than a tiny supply of materials to advance your findings.
These are just some useful things that are usually not required for progression, but are more for Quality of Life than anything else.
Generators, Generators, and more Generators.
The Ancient Scholars of Blood Magic made the edgiest of magic possible... and now they are gated at the mercy of the flowers and stars.
With added tree puns as a bonus. Do note, this line is fairly optional, but if you want to gain resources with bees you can.
Digital Items. Store your items virtually!
But first we need to talk about parallel universes.

Here are free possible bases for those of you who do not want to waste time gathering materials or trying to design a structure yourself. These come as Blueprints that you merely need the materials in your inventory to make, which the rewards provide. Please do not cannibalize them for resources. But feel free to add onto or modify them.
